subject.title: [Bug]: Tool display missing file path when model uses "file" parameter alias

question: Should Read/Write/Edit display and read-start diagnostics continue recognizing legacy path aliases such as `file`, `filePath`, and `file_path` even though current execution validation rejects alias-only calls?
rationale: Current main has a source-repro display/diagnostic gap, but current tests also encode canonical `path` as the runtime contract, so automation cannot safely choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve display/diagnostic alias compatibility
options.body: Treat aliases as accepted presentation inputs, refresh the linked PR or replacement to update the active handler, metadata, and tests, while keeping execution validation policy explicit.

options.title: Canonicalize on `path` only
options.body: Document or test that alias-only calls are rejected and update display/diagnostic expectations so stale alias support is removed consistently.

recommendation.title: Preserve display/diagnostic alias compatibility
recommendation.body: Treat aliases as accepted presentation inputs, refresh the linked PR or replacement to update the active handler, metadata, and tests, while keeping execution validation policy explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the current active handler, runtime validation direction, and recent agent-runtime refactor history tied to this path.
